note: Shrink-only debt, measured 2026-09-18 (DR-0514). A workflow that files a finding to the incident ledger and does NOT also append to a rolling run log is a witness whose SILENCE is ambiguous: it means either 'nothing is wrong' or 'the witness never ran', and those cannot be told apart. level-witness.yml got a run log on 2026-09-17 after its first clean run left nothing behind; site-health.yml got one on 2026-09-18 after being dispatched to prove a merge had reached the live site and producing no observable record at all. The four listed here still file only on failure. They are recorded rather than retrofitted in one pass because each needs its OWN measured outputs named in its line -- a log that says 'unknown' for every field is theatre, which is the failure DR-0076 section 3 forbids. This list may only SHRINK, and a NEW incident-filing workflow must carry a run log from its first commit. re-review: 2026-09-25. 2026-09-19: node-availability.yml healed. Its incident ledger had been silent since 2026-09-03 and, asked on 2026-09-18 whether both CUDA towers were up, nobody could tell "the fleet is healthy" from "the witness stopped running" -- on the ONE instrument that reports which machines are reachable at all. Three remain.
